title: Several Fortinet products: attackers can read or change files
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 207 days old, so many systems are likely still unpatched.

category.label: VPN, firewall or gateway
category.why: It sits at the edge of your network and faces the internet, so attackers can reach it directly.
category.doThis: If you have it, patch it today. If you cannot, block access to it from the internet until you can.

summary: FortiOS, FortiPAM, FortiProxy, and FortiSwitchManager contain a path traversal vulnerability that may allow an authenticated attacker with admin profile and at least read-write permissions to write or delete arbitrary files via specific CLI commands.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Oct 19, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.

evidence.title: Fortinet Multiple Products Path Traversal Vulnerability
CISA Vulnrichment marks CVE-2025-61624 as actively exploited
